remarks: Welcome home to this fabulous condo in Downtown Stamford! Filled with natural light, this large one bedroom, one bathroom unit has everything. Enjoy a generous sized living room that can also easily accommodate a desk and/or table. The kitchen has ample counter space with a built in bar alongside plenty of cabinets. The bathroom has been completely renovated featuring new floors, wall tile and vanity. The complex is ideally situated close to everything including Scalzi Park, Starbucks, LA Fitness, Stop and Shop and more. Schedule a tour to see this beautiful unit today!
